description: Terri served in the United States Air Force as a JAG (military lawyer) and retired as a Colonel after 29 years of combined active duty and reserve service. Terri is a former State Representative from 2015-2022, serving the citizens of House District 20. She is proud that a significant number of conservative bills she carried came from issues raised by people in the district and local officials in El Paso County.
